description.value: The Lewis Centre is a municipal recreation and sports facility operated by the City of Courtenay on Vancouver Island, offering drop-in fitness, drop-in sports, a Wellness Centre, personal training, and adapted programs. It is one of several City of Courtenay recreation facilities and serves the broader Comox Valley community. Touring cyclists passing through Courtenay may find it a practical stop, though specific cyclist-facing amenities have not been confirmed from available sources.
